description: This file defines the StreamId struct used for identifying streams within Orleans streaming infrastructure, including methods for creation, comparison, serialization, and string formatting.

classes.name: StreamId
classes.description: A struct representing a unique identifier for a stream within Orleans, supporting comparison, serialization, and string formatting.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Static factory methods to create StreamId instances from various input types such as spans, strings, GUIDs, longs, and stream identities.

methods.name: CompareTo
methods.description: Compares this StreamId with another for ordering.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code for this StreamId.

methods.name: GetKeyAsString
methods.description: Returns the key component as a UTF-8 string.

methods.name: GetNamespace
methods.description: Returns the namespace component as a UTF-8 string.
